description: Gear uo with Rothco's Tactical Assault Panel (TAP), a versatile addition to your tactical setup. This panel offers unparalleled flexibility with multiple MOLLE straps and pockets designed to accommodate various tactical accessories such as gun magazines, knives, and more. Whether you're on duty or engaged in outdoor activities, the TAP ensures you have quick access to your essential gear. The TAP features an adjustable and removable harness, allowing you to wear it as a standalone system tailored to your specific needs. Its six magazine pockets provide secure storage for ammunition, each equipped with strong hook and loop closures for added security. Additionally, two outer hook and loop strap pockets on either end of the magazine pockets offer convenient storage options for GPS devices, radios, or additional magazines. For enhanced organization, the back panel of the TAP is equipped with three large mesh pockets. The left and center pockets feature hook and loop closures, while the right pocket is zippered, providing ample space for storing maps, compasses, and other accessories. Designed for compatibility with plate carrier systems and tactical vests, the TAP comes with shoulder plate carrier adapters and split bar side release buckles. This allows for easy attachment to your existing gear setup, ensuring seamless integration into your tactical ensemble. Constructed from rugged combat-ready material, the TAP is built to withstand the rigors of demanding environments. Its middle panel pocket measures 11.5 inches x 8.75 inches, providing ample space for storing essential items. The front panel features three rows of MOLLE straps for mounting additional attachments, while the included shoulder adapters offer added versatility. Whether you're a active-duty professional, law enforcement officer, or outdoor enthusiast, the Rothco Tactical Assault Panel offers unmatched versatility and functionality for all your tactical needs.
